tasks.title: Motor frequency from eRPM
tasks.solution: RPM = eRPM / (poles/2), f = RPM/60. A wrong motor_poles shifts every notch: with 12 instead of 14 the filter lands at 7/6 of the real frequency.

tasks.title: Third harmonic vs. the lower bound
tasks.solution: The k-th harmonic is k·RPM/60. If the fundamental is below rpm_filter_min_hz, its notch sits at the bound, off target from the noise; higher harmonics are filtered.
